name: owl-tools
description: Static tools site. The single dependency is the storage client behind the Netlify functions: Pokemon Champions sync and Civ: A New Dawn multiplayer sessions.

comments.@netlify/blobs: Must be >=11: the Civ session store depends on conditional writes (onlyIfNew / onlyIfMatch) and on set/setJSON returning { modified }. In v8 those options are silently ignored and setJSON returns void, which made every room creation report session_exists.
